text_aliases.No member record found for Member ID: No member record found for Member Number

notes:
Same MERIDIAN CORE 4.2 build as northstar-cu, configured and branded by a
different institution. Three aliases are the entire difference:
  * two controls are renamed (Member ID -> Member Number, Search -> Find Member)
  * the recorded MEMBER_NOT_FOUND detector quotes the app's message, which
    embeds this deployment's name for the id field

Deliberately NOT overridden, because nothing needs it:
  * the accounts grid runs its columns in a different order (Account Number |
    Type | Status | Balance). The recorded reads address cells by row text and
    column heading, so they are order-independent already.
  * this deployment shows a post-sign-on compliance notice. It renders through
    the product's standard notice chrome, which the base capability's
    `dismiss_system_notice` recovery rule already matches -- replays here show
    it firing, and succeeding, as a drift signal rather than a failure.
  * the sign-on flow, the member summary captions, the step postcondition and
    the success checkpoint are all identical across both deployments.

Review note: the text alias is avoidable. The detector only needs the stable
prefix 'No member record found'; the discovery run happened to record the
longer sentence. Tightening it in the base capability would shrink this
overlay to the two genuine control renames -- which is exactly the kind of
thing capability review is for, and why recordings land as drafts.
